# technitium_zone_dnssec (Data Source)

Reads the DNSSEC signing of a zone, for example its DS records for the parent zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_zone_dnssec" "home" {
  zone = "home.example.com"
}

output "home_signed" {
  value = data.technitium_zone_dnssec.home.signed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone` (String) The zone.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The signing algorithm: `RSA`, `ECDSA` or `EDDSA`.
- `curve` (String) The curve, for `ECDSA` and `EDDSA`.
- `dns_key_ttl` (Number) The TTL of the DNSKEY records.
- `ds_records` (Attributes List) The DS records for the parent zone. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ds_records))
- `hash_algorithm` (String) The hash, for `RSA`.
- `keys` (Attributes List) The zone's keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))
- `nsec3_iterations` (Number) The NSEC3 hash iterations.
- `nsec3_salt_length` (Number) The NSEC3 salt length in bytes.
- `nx_proof` (String) `NSEC` or `NSEC3`.
- `signed` (Boolean) Whether the zone is signed.
- `status` (String) The signing status: `Unsigned`, `SignedWithNSEC` or `SignedWithNSEC3`.
- `zsk_rollover_days` (Number) The days between zone signing key rollovers.

<a id="nestedatt--ds_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ds_records`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) The algorithm name.
- `algorithm_number` (Number) The algorithm number.
- `digest` (String) The digest.
- `digest_type` (String) The digest type.
- `digest_type_number` (Number) The digest type number.
- `key_tag` (Number) The key tag.


<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) The DNSKEY algorithm.
- `key_tag` (Number) The key tag.
- `key_type` (String) `KeySigningKey` or `ZoneSigningKey`.
- `rollover_days` (Number) The days between rollovers.
- `state` (String) The key state.
